title: Anthropic Delivers Huge News for Nvidia Stock, AMD Stock, Micron Stock, and Broadcom Stock Investors
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: Parkevtate covers Anthropic's planned IPO, expected 18-20 November at a valuation of roughly $1.4 trillion, which he rates as good: he had told viewers $1-1.5 trillion would be solid and $1.5-2 trillion excellent. Anthropic plans to sell 825 million shares at $70-78, raising about $64.35 billion at the top of the range, and is locking down an extra $26 billion of strategic buying from Nvidia, Microsoft, Google, TSMC, Broadcom, AMD and Micron. He reads that $26 billion as strategic rather than a value judgement: those companies want Anthropic to succeed because it is one of their biggest customers, and the buying sets a floor under the IPO valuation and reduces the chance of a crash at listing. Anthropic's revenue soared 1,200% to $33 billion through the first nine months of the year, and it has about $900 billion of aggregate committed spend, mostly compute and infrastructure, which will flow largely to those same suppliers. The roughly $90 billion raised is a small fraction of what Anthropic will need, and the business is still losing money, but with this growth he would not be surprised if it reaches a more sustainable footing within 12 months. He will not buy the IPO himself: IPOs are too volatile, hard to get shares in, and thin on information. But he is very interested in Anthropic succeeding because he owns many of its suppliers, including Nvidia, Microsoft, Google, Broadcom, AMD, Micron, Amazon and Qualcomm. No calls are made in this video.
